steps.title: Navigate to the Dashboard
steps.narration: The dashboard loads normally, showing the current market state without errors.
steps.point_out: Look for the Market Phase & Severity card with a real numeric severity score and phase label.

steps.title: Check the readiness badge at the top right
steps.narration: The header's readiness pill shows a solid green state with a clear status.
steps.point_out: The pill in the top-right corner should read 'Ready' with a green indicator.

steps.title: View the Data Manager and coverage panels
steps.narration: The Data Manager page displays the dataset coverage and universe resolution information with real numbers for universe counts and admissions.
steps.point_out: The Dataset coverage panel shows the Universe count, Admitted count, and the breakdown of excluded items by reason. All figures should be real numbers, not blanks.

steps.title: View the Backtest page with evidence scorecard
steps.narration: The Backtest page shows the forward-test scorecard with real historical data and evidence metrics, confirming that evidence is served from storage, not computed on demand.
steps.point_out: Scroll down to the evidence section to see the 'Snapshots contributing' count displayed as a real number, not a loading spinner.

steps.title: Check the background-compute panel on Data Manager
steps.narration: The background-compute panel discloses any active or recently-completed background computation, with a footer explaining the scope ('process-lifetime only, never persisted').
steps.point_out: Look for either an active in-flight entry or a 'Last outcome' summary, confirming the backend honestly reports its background work.

steps.title: Confirm badge consistency across Dashboard
steps.narration: The readiness badge and preflight banner render consistently in the header across all three pages, confirming a single global element.
steps.point_out: The pill in the top-right corner should show the same 'Ready' state and position as it did on the earlier pages.
